stages.name: RMM+ Extension Authentication Bypass
observables: POST requests to ScreenConnect servers with blank RMMPlus.AccessKey

scenario.summary: Attackers exploit an authentication flaw in the third-party RMM+ extension for ScreenConnect to push commands to managed endpoints. The resulting SCKit worm establishes persistence via high-frequency scheduled tasks and registry keys, hijacks legitimate client connections, and steals technician session cookies to propagate laterally through the ScreenConnect shared toolbox.

hunt.name: ScreenConnect Session Theft and Toolbox Propagation
hunt.description: This hunt identifies the harvesting of ScreenConnect session cookies from technician browsers and the subsequent use of those hijacked sessions for lateral movement. The SCKit worm automates cookie extraction using a scripted SQLite utility and then broadcasts payloads to all endpoints accessible through the technician's ScreenConnect panel using a custom uploader tool. The hunt begins by identifying the execution of core worm scripts (Panel-Lateral.ps1, LabConfig.ps1) and the specialized uploader binary. It then fan-outs to verify the mechanism of theft—specifically sqlite3.exe interacting with browser database paths—and checks for connections to identified attacker relay infrastructure from those same hosts. An agent weighs these signals to determine if a host is an active beachhead for propagation.

nodes.label: SCKit worm scripts and uploader execution

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, process_name, process_cmd_line, time FROM hb_process_activity WHERE (LOWER(process_cmd_line) LIKE '%panel-lateral.ps1%' OR LOWER(process_cmd_line) LIKE '%labconfig.ps1%' OR LOWER(process_name) = 'toolboxrelayuploader.exe' OR (LOWER(process_name) = 'sqlite3.exe' AND (LOWER(process_cmd_line) LIKE '%cookies%' OR LOWER(process_cmd_line) LIKE '%login data%'))) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')
config.description: Find the primary execution of the worm's harvesting and propagation components.
config.expected_signal: Any row indicates the worm's presence. Silence suggests the harvesting phase has not started or used different filenames.
